ProjectService is the installation's projects (spin#720): a repository and the shape of the. workspace that opens it (CreateWorkspaceRequest.project_id). Anybody signed in makes one where. the installation lets everybody (InstallationSettings.project_creation), and is its first admin. A project is seen by everybody while it is shared with everyone, and otherwise by its admins and. whom it is shared with; the instance's admins see and administer every one. Whoever sees one. opens workspaces from it, in a team of theirs.

## CreateProject

`POST /spin.v1.ProjectService/CreateProject`

**Request**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  |
| `slug` | string | Made from the name when empty |
| `description` | string |  |
| `repository` | string |  |
| `ref` | string |  |
| `image` | string |  |
| `preset` | string |  |
| `networkTags` | list of string |  |
| `prebuildRefs` | list of string |  |
| `prebuildRebaseEvery` | integer (int32) | Zero is the installation's default |

**Response**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | [Project](/reference/api/types/#project) |  |

## ListPrebuilds

`POST /spin.v1.ProjectService/ListPrebuilds`

A project's prebuilds, to whoever sees it; and a build of one of its refs now, by its admins, rather than at the next look.

**Request**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `projectId` | string |  |

**Response**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `prebuilds` | list of [Prebuild](/reference/api/types/#prebuild) | Newest first. |

## UpdateProject

`POST /spin.v1.ProjectService/UpdateProject`

Changed, shared and deleted by its admins. A project with a workspace open on it is not deleted.
